description: This file defines a Python class LLMLogObserver which observes and logs various frames related to Language Model (LLM) activity, such as responses, messages, function calls, and context frames. It is specifically tailored for logging LLM interactions within the Pipecat framework, focusing on frames exchanged between an LLMService and other components.

classes.name: LLMLogObserver
classes.description: A class that observes LLM-related activity frames, logging their details based on frame type and direction to help monitor LLM interactions within the system.

methods.name: on_push_frame(self, data: FramePushed)
methods.description: Asynchronous method that handles incoming frame push events, inspects the frame and source/destination, and logs relevant information about LLM activity depending on the frame type and direction.
